from pathlib import Path
p = Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/coredump.rs')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('''    /// The raw pointer identity of the Wasm instance used for deduplication.
    key: usize,''', '''    /// The stable arena index of the Wasm instance used for deduplication.
    key: usize,''')
s = s.replace('''    /// The raw pointer identity of the memory used for deduplication.
    key: usize,''', '''    /// The stable arena index of the memory used for deduplication.
    key: usize,''')
s = s.replace('''    /// The raw pointer identity of the global used for deduplication.
    key: usize,''', '''    /// The stable arena index of the global used for deduplication.
    key: usize,''')
p.write_text(s)
print("done")
